summary: This video discusses rumors and confirmation from the Chinese servers regarding the return of Anneliesis, one of the most powerful and versatile support heroes in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. The creators detail her unique kit, which provides massive team buffs, crowd control, buff removal, cleansing, shields, and target-HP-scaled healing. They strongly advise all players, including free-to-play players, to start saving at least 300 Heliolite Dice to guarantee acquiring her on her upcoming banner.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Provides possess buffs to bonded allies, full-board knockup/stun, complete buff removal, full debuff cleansing, shields, and massive healing scaling off target HP.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Scales heavily off HP damage and pairs exceptionally well with Anneliesis's HP and damage boost passive.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Provides Aura energy and damage buffs that synergize with Anneliesis in pure Aura comps.

teams.note: A core Aura comp where Anneliesis provides shields, healing, CC, and massive HP/damage scaling to Talethia.

meta_changes: Re-run of limited event/exclusive hero Anneliesis on a dedicated banner, allowing newer accounts access to the premier Aura support.
tips: Always save 300 Heliolite Dice (or equivalent Wyrmarrow) so you can hit full pity on key hero banners like Anneliesis.
Farm all available story, journey, and Fey Corridor content to accumulate missing Heliolite Dice before the banner arrives.
Build Anneliesis with high Accuracy if you need her buff removal/CC, or high Resistance/Defense for general survivability; her healing scales on target Max HP rather than her own stats.
title: Most OP Hero Is Coming Back? Anneliesis Banner Talk ft. @OddOneGamingRPGs⁂ Dragonheir: Silent Gods
